title: CPCB E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022 Regulatory Framework
authority: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)

rules.clause: Rule 4 & Schedule III - Mandatory EPR Targets
rules.summary: Under Rule 4 of the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022, all registered Manufacturers, Producers, Recyclers, and Refurbishers must achieve phase-wise Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) recycling targets. The recycling quota is set at 60% of annual e-waste generated for FY 2023-24 and FY 2024-25, increasing to 70% for FY 2025-26 & 2026-27, and reaching 80% from FY 2027-28 onward.

rules.clause: Rule 14 & CPCB Guidelines - Registration Fee Tiers
rules.summary: Registration fees on the official CPCB EPR portal are slab-based, derived directly from the calculated EPR Recycling Target (in Metric Tonnes). Fees range from ₹2,500 for targets below 50 MT, up to ₹15,00,000 for large-scale operations exceeding 5,000 MT per annum.

Compliance status ('Compliant' vs 'Non-Compliant') is calculated by validating actual recycled e-waste tonnage against the legally mandated EPR target (MT). Non-compliant entities face environmental compensation penalties and audit reviews under CPCB EPR portal verification mechanisms.
